name: Cobalt
delivery_note: The company's own materials describe work being resold or subcontracted rather than staffed from its own payroll.
specialty: Pentest as a service platform with a vetted tester pool and orchestration.
notes: Cobalt (cobalt.io) is a crowdsourced pentest platform with no Norwegian entity. Note that an unrelated Norwegian company, COBALT AS (org.nr 924359005, Oslo), shares the name and must not be confused with it.
